summary: High Tide Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the adoption of new shareholder rights plans (a temporary and an amended and restated plan) to maintain compliance with cannabis regulations and ensure fair treatment in any take-over bid. The plans were not adopted in response to any known bid. They expand the definition of Acquiring Person to include certain cannabis license holders. The amended plan requires shareholder ratification and has a three-year term. This is a defensive governance measure, not a special situation event.
